selected_candidates.text: The main site wouldn’t require a booking system because its sibling sites would handle the bookings.

llm_evaluation.reason: The message clarifies the boundary between two active requirements: the master site must not host bookings, while sibling location sites retain booking responsibility. Earlier evidence is needed to preserve the master-site role and location-specific Wix booking architecture rather than incorrectly removing booking functionality altogether or implementing it on the master site. The clarification is sufficient to act without further inquiry, but it does not itself request a code change.

selected_candidates.speaker: client
selected_candidates.text:
Hey! Here is the vision I have for the website.

The objective is to create a national brand website for SMASH ROOM that can accommodate multiple locations and support future franchise growth.

Primary Website:
[URL_006]

I would like a clean, modern, mobile-friendly design with simplicity comparable to iSmashUSA. The branding should use black, purple, and white, with large images, generous spacing, and straightforward navigation.

Sections for the Homepage:

Hero Banner
Location Selector
Rage Rooms
Axe Throwing
Splatter Room
Corporate Events
Birthday Parties
Reviews
FAQ
Contact

The homepage needs to show visitors our offerings right away and let them choose their location.

Locations at Present:

Fairfield, CA
San Francisco, CA
Seattle, WA

Every location should have a dedicated page of its own, while the design and branding remain consistent across all locations.

The site should be structured so that future locations can be added easily without requiring a redesign.

Possible future examples:

Phoenix
Denver
Austin
Franchise Locations

Overall, it should feel like a national entertainment brand rather than a local business website.

llm_evaluation.reason: The current vision is concrete but omits material established architecture: the master site has no booking system, and its location selector routes visitors to separate Wix location sites. It also modifies prior template, branding, design-reference, and location requirements while introducing homepage and responsive-design requirements. Ignoring history could incorrectly create internal booking flows or misapply the location-site model, so the task strongly tests selection, current-state reconstruction, and faithful website implementation without requiring clarification.

selected_candidates.speaker: client
selected_candidates.text: Use theirs as the design reference.

llm_evaluation.reason: The phrase “theirs” is interpretable only from the immediately preceding clarification and earlier design-reference history. It resolves the open competitor-versus-mockup ambiguity in favor of the latest competitor sites, so ignoring history could select the wrong design direction or prompt unnecessary clarification.
